title: Offline short video player
summary: Offline video player for vertical and short videos
description:
Offline short video player is the perfect video player app to play vertically recorded videos and short-form videos saved in your phone.

You can download short videos from short-video platforms to your phone and play them with Offline short video player for the best experience.

Offline short video player supports all popular video formats, 4K/ultra HD video files and plays them in high definition. It is the most suitable video player for vertically videos and short-form videos saved on your phone.

Key Features:
• Supports ALL video formats: MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, 3GP, FLV, WMV, RMVB, TS, and more.
• Ultra HD video player with 4K support.
• Hardware acceleration for smooth playback.
• Automatic video detection on both device storage and SD card.
• Easy video management and sharing.
• Swipe up to switch to the next video.
• Smooth gestures and controls.
• Multiple zoom options to fit different screen ratios.
• HD video player optimized for Android tablets and phones.

If you have any suggestions or questions about Offline short video player, feel free to contact us!
